notes: TechLog gives Fenix's EFB more room: it keeps away for 60 seconds while Fenix loads, then asks gently until Fenix answers quickly, and asks less often afterwards.
The fan ice inspection after icing without engine anti-ice now comes after 30 minutes (deferrable) and 60 minutes (NO-GO), not 10 and 15.
A restart of TechLog in cruise no longer starts the fuel at the outside air temperature and raises false cold fuel warnings.
